verdict.rationale: Jan's own docs show it downloads and runs open LLMs locally (Llama, Gemma, Qwen, GGUF imports) and serves them through a llama.cpp-powered API server that 'runs entirely on your computer'. Its privacy page claims zero data collection by default. Cloud providers are opt-in, so fully local use is a documented mode, not a workaround. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification that no prompts or telemetry leave the device during local-only use.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run inference entirely on my own machine so my data and prompts never leave my device
